sections.title: Dril'thar
sections.text:
name: Dril'thar

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Small to modestly sized amphibious people, usually about one to four feet tall, with sinewy limbs, damp protective skin, webbed hands and feet, and often a powerful prehensile tail. Sensory fins or frills can frame the head. Large reflective eyes, color-shifting patterns, and luminous markings permit both speech and visual expression. They can move upright or on four limbs; moisture is essential to their health.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Dril’thars

parental_ancestry: []

subtypes: [{"name":"Grassland","appearance":"Light sky blue, pale tan or sun-washed gold surfaces adapted to open wet meadows. Legs remain strong for leaping and traversing shallow water.","status":"strict JSON","appearance_approval":"author approved 2026-10-11"},{"name":"Lush Forest","appearance":"Moss green, bark brown and lichen gray coloring; fine rootlike patterns help bodies blend into shaded wet woodland.","status":"strict JSON","appearance_approval":"author approved 2026-10-11"},{"name":"Marsh","appearance":"Peat brown, slate gray and murky green mottling, often with a denser protective skin coating for stagnant wetlands.","status":"strict JSON","appearance_approval":"author approved 2026-10-11"},{"name":"Rainforest","appearance":"Vivid emerald, sapphire or violet skins carrying bright bioluminescent rainlike markings and pronounced sensory frills.","status":"strict JSON","appearance_approval":"author approved 2026-10-11"},{"name":"Ocean","appearance":"Ocean lineages may be slightly larger, with elongated swimming profiles, reflective seafoam or deep blue skin, and strong tails.","status":"strict JSON","appearance_approval":"author approved 2026-10-11"},{"name":"Reef","appearance":"Brilliant reds, turquoise, luminous pink and textured coral-like patterning; fins and webbing support reef-water movement.","status":"strict JSON","appearance_approval":"author approved 2026-10-11"}]

naming: {"influences":["Ancient or Old Egyptian","Navajo (Diné Bizaad)","Taa (!Xóõ / !Xoon)"],"template":"Honor name = optional click onset + one or two fictional roots + community ending. A click may also appear medially; ceremonial and everyday names can differ.","syllable_pattern":"Optional CLICK + CV.CV or CV.CV.CV; do not require a click in every name","examples":[{"name":"ǃKhemaru","reading":"[alveolar click] kheh-MAH-roo","proposed_meaning":"One who guards river memory"},{"name":"ǀSenaki","reading":"[dental click] seh-NAH-kee","proposed_meaning":"Listener along the sheltered path"},{"name":"ǁNamaru","reading":"[lateral click] nah-MAH-roo","proposed_meaning":"The water remembers their light"},{"name":"ǂTsenahe","reading":"[palatal click] tseh-NAH-heh","proposed_meaning":"A guide through mist"},{"name":"ʘMekanu","reading":"[bilabial click] meh-KAH-noo","proposed_meaning":"Guardian of the living spring"}]}

historical_identity: Dril'thar has always been the sole name for these amphibious peoples and their lineages. No alternate ancestral species name is part of canon.

sections.title: Kaluseban
sections.text:
name: Kaluseban

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Tall, slender, graceful magic-dependent humanoids with features that vary markedly among bloodlines. Skin may range from pale ivory through earth green and brown to deep sapphire. Eyes glow faintly in the color of their affinity, while fine hair can shimmer or float in dense ambient magic. Appearance should communicate personal lineage, not a single uniform skin color.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Kalusebans

parental_ancestry: []

sections.title: Azrahai
sections.text:
name: Azrahai

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Original Aza'ran draconic people whose living anatomy includes scales, a powerful tail, clawed hands, facial ridges and, where appropriate to lineage, wings. Bodies range from heavy mineral-armored to long and streamlined. Ancient records call these same people Azh’raim; their modern name is Azrahai.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Azh’raim

sections.title: Panolima
sections.text:
name: Panolima

status: strict JSON species

appearance: People whose bodies visibly reflect one of five elemental affinities, rather than a separate generic Elementaris species. Some are solid as stone, some carry ember patterns, others appear fluid, airy or illuminated by magical energy. Their silhouettes and voices may change with the environment; none of those forms should be mistaken for a separate current species.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Panolimas

parental_ancestry: []

name: Jaspey

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Jaspey are recognized as one people with three established forms, Mosscap, Gloomtail, and Rotcap. Each form has identifiable surface markings or anatomy. Their shared underlying body plan is not specified in the surviving current reference, so no extra height, limb count, or facial anatomy is invented here.

sections.text:

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Tall to towering magical shapeshifters, sometimes feline or beastlike, whose physiques vary from muscular to lithe. Fur, scales or earth-toned skin, reflective eyes, wings, tails or other animal features vary according to the individual's soul bond. No single default animal form applies to every member.

sections.text:

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Wiry or lithe agile figures, roughly three to six feet tall in the detailed source, with softly luminous skin and shifting freckle-like or sigil markings. Hair can range from honey and copper to chestnut, jade and gold. Eyes may glow subtly when magic is active; layered clothes and charms suit travel and performance.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Gandiroshas

sections.text:
name: Geisamahi

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Small, upright, ferret- or stoatlike people with compact wiry bodies, elongated muzzles, expressive eyes, twitching whiskers and opposable thumbs. Fur may be brown, russet, orange, snow white or patterned. Their movement is nimble and acrobatic, and they often carry small belts and handmade tools.

sections.title: Tamhiogal
sections.text:
name: Tamhiogal

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Amphibious aquatic people with dramatic betta-fish coloration: brilliant blues, violets, teals, reds and shifting iridescence. On land they have scaled humanoid legs and arms, bioluminescent jellyfish-like hair, reflective eyes and scales at the face and neck. In water, gills, webbing, dorsal fins and a long caudal fin become prominent. They need hydration and tidal energy.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Tamhiogals

parental_ancestry: []

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Infernal magical beings with a humanoid and a quadrupedal equine-inspired form. Humanoid skin can resemble obsidian, molten iron or violet stone, marked by ember veins and living sigils. Curved or bladelike horns, fire-bright or voidlike eyes, varied hair and a prehensile tail distinguish individuals. The equine form adds a muscular horse-like trunk and hooved legs.

status: strict JSON species

appearance: Ethereal four-armed people with elongated ear horns, sensitive antennae, iridescent skin and luminous or nebula-like eyes. Hair can look like liquid light, drifting mist or fine feathers. sections.title: Kalus’aan
sections.text:
name: Kalus’aan

status: documented mixed ancestry, not separate approved species

appearance: Documented Aza’raan and Kaluseban mixed-ancestry community. Their Aza’raan cranial ridges, slender limbs, silver, blue, or green eyes and copper-to-auburn hair may mingle with Kaluseban color shifts, luminous marks, mineral textures, water-adapted accents, or forest and shadow features. The six documented Kalus’aan expressions are Arcane, Starborne, Wildroot, Tideborn, Stonebound, and Umbral; they are not six separate species. Appearance differs with the family and the particular Kaluseban bloodline.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Kalus’aans

parental_ancestry: ["Aza’raan","Kaluseban"]

sections.title: Aza’raan
sections.text:
name: Aza’raan

status: established Aza’raan people in race document, outside strict JSON

appearance: Aza'raans are generally tall, slender and graceful, with long limbs and a very pale to slightly tanned complexion. The usual unmixed skin-color range resembles fair to lightly tanned complexions seen among Italian, Slavic and Balkan human populations, without implying any shared Earth ethnic identity. Copper, deep copper, auburn and dark auburn are the most common hair colors. Brown appears sometimes, while black and blonde are rare. Silver, blue and green eyes are common, often with a distinctly oceanic shape, occasionally dual-toned or subtly reflective. High oceanic-style cheekbones, a slightly angular brow with shallow paired ridges, and long ears swept backward are defining traits. Ear tips range from moderately pointed to dramatically sharp and elongated, with individual variation. Some Aza'raans bear faint freckles, subtle psionic luminescence, or wave-like ritual markings. Kaluseban, Deorbasun, Zirramunis, Iamhazira and Gandirosha ancestry can introduce additional color, stature, ear, hair, eye, animal-associated, or magical characteristics; such variation does not redefine the typical unmixed appearance.

source: [RACES] Races.docx: Aza’raans; author-approved Aza'raan coloring and heritage corrections 2026-10-11

family_appearance_note: Pix family appearance canon: Pix is a transgender man who can pass as human despite his visibly pointed, backward-swept ears. The childhood name 'Pix' came from those conspicuous ears, which his parents explained as an old inherited abnormality. Pix and his father have the tell-tale pointed ears. Pix's mother, Jacob and Clarahmizah have ordinary-looking human ears without points. Pix's mother eventually explains that much of the protector bloodline shared by her and Clarahmizah has Gandirosha and Zirramunis ancestry, and many descendants lost the conspicuous Aza'raan ear shape. Pix inherited the unmistakable ears through his father. The absence of pointed ears does not erase anyone's Aza'raan lineage or protector heritage.

structured_records.name: Dril'thar
structured_records.appearance: Small to modestly sized amphibious people, usually about one to four feet tall, with sinewy limbs, damp protective skin, webbed hands and feet, and often a powerful prehensile tail. Sensory fins or frills can frame the head. Large reflective eyes, color-shifting patterns, and luminous markings permit both speech and visual expression. They can move upright or on four limbs; moisture is essential to their health.

subtypes.name: Grassland
subtypes.appearance: Light sky blue, pale tan or sun-washed gold surfaces adapted to open wet meadows. Legs remain strong for leaping and traversing shallow water.

subtypes.name: Lush Forest
subtypes.appearance: Moss green, bark brown and lichen gray coloring; fine rootlike patterns help bodies blend into shaded wet woodland.

subtypes.name: Marsh
subtypes.appearance: Peat brown, slate gray and murky green mottling, often with a denser protective skin coating for stagnant wetlands.

subtypes.name: Rainforest
subtypes.appearance: Vivid emerald, sapphire or violet skins carrying bright bioluminescent rainlike markings and pronounced sensory frills.

subtypes.name: Ocean
subtypes.appearance: Ocean lineages may be slightly larger, with elongated swimming profiles, reflective seafoam or deep blue skin, and strong tails.

subtypes.name: Reef
subtypes.appearance: Brilliant reds, turquoise, luminous pink and textured coral-like patterning; fins and webbing support reef-water movement.

naming.template: Honor name = optional click onset + one or two fictional roots + community ending. A click may also appear medially; ceremonial and everyday names can differ.
naming.syllable_pattern: Optional CLICK + CV.CV or CV.CV.CV; do not require a click in every name

structured_records.historical_identity: Dril'thar has always been the sole name for these amphibious peoples and their lineages. No alternate ancestral species name is part of canon.

structured_records.name: Kaluseban
structured_records.appearance: Tall, slender, graceful magic-dependent humanoids with features that vary markedly among bloodlines. Skin may range from pale ivory through earth green and brown to deep sapphire. Eyes glow faintly in the color of their affinity, while fine hair can shimmer or float in dense ambient magic. Appearance should communicate personal lineage, not a single uniform skin color.

subtypes.name: Psionic
subtypes.appearance: psionic light in the eyes or temple markings can be an individual appearance cue.

subtypes.name: Swamp
subtypes.appearance: Wetland greens and browns with reed-like markings are characteristic possible looks. The historic text describes woodland and marsh-linked ancestors, but not every detail of this current label.

subtypes.name: Arcane
subtypes.appearance: Luminous pale or violet skin and shifting magical markings are among the approved options for an arcane lineage.

subtypes.name: Dark
subtypes.appearance: Low-light, shadow-touched coloring and dim luminescence can occur in this bloodline.

subtypes.name: Stone
subtypes.appearance: Source describes granite, sandstone and muted moonstone coloration, crystalline highlights, and markings reminiscent of stone inscriptions.

subtypes.name: Oceanic
subtypes.appearance: Pearlescent aquamarine or tide-blue color and water-adapted accents are approved visual options.

naming.template: Fuse a Korean-inspired meaningful root and French-inspired root. Transform both for the fictional Kaluseban phonology; avoid simply attaching two unchanged real words.

examples.name: Yermifana
examples.proposed_meaning: A steadfast spirit whose resolve never breaks

examples.name: Meryefina
examples.proposed_meaning: Unwavering devotion of heart and purpose

examples.name: Salmyeoro
examples.proposed_meaning: Firmly grounded, enduring through every change

structured_records.name: Azrahai
structured_records.appearance: Original Aza'ran draconic people whose living anatomy includes scales, a powerful tail, clawed hands, facial ridges and, where appropriate to lineage, wings. Bodies range from heavy mineral-armored to long and streamlined. Ancient records call these same people Azh’raim; their modern name is Azrahai.

subtypes.name: Noitzideq
subtypes.appearance: Tall with layered green or blue-green scales, gold and dark speckles, feather-edged aerodynamic wings, and a muscular tail.

subtypes.name: Saelftum
subtypes.appearance: Massive, volcanic-adapted build with charcoal or black scales, amber and red accents, broad wings, horns and molten-looking fissures.

subtypes.name: Jazwed
subtypes.appearance: Coarse red-green iridescent scales, crystal clusters, dense muscular frame and shorter gliding wings adapted to heat.

subtypes.name: Khoalaros
subtypes.appearance: Long aquatic body with dark reflective scales, bioluminescent veins, webbed extremities, dorsal fins and swimming-capable wings and tail.

subtypes.name: Gauksneth
subtypes.appearance: Pale sand-colored crystalline scales, slim limbs and long sail-like wings suited to arid terrain.

subtypes.name: Tuorszom
subtypes.appearance: Gray, brown and black layered scales with mineral streaks, protective plates, and broad climbing hands and feet.

subtypes.name: Taudinax
subtypes.appearance: Dark iridescent scales, semi-translucent patches, silent wings, elongated fingers and a flexible tail.

subtypes.name: Gouxelq
subtypes.appearance: Deep blue metallic scales, crystal protrusions on shoulders and knuckles, heavy frame and broad flight wings.

subtypes.name: Vautaces
subtypes.appearance: Smooth ruby-red and cream scales with radiant crystal edging, long fingers, elegant wings and fine facial ridges.

naming.template: Clan root + chosen element or vocation root; historical lineage titles remain unchanged.

examples.name: Zarikome
examples.proposed_meaning: A vow protected by the storm

examples.name: Korotavi
examples.proposed_meaning: One who opens a new path

examples.name: Tavikoro
examples.proposed_meaning: First watcher of the high wind

structured_records.naming_transition: Azh’raim gradually simplified to Azrahai across generations. The precise transition date has not been established. This is a historical name change within one species, not the merger of two species.

structured_records.name: Panolima
structured_records.appearance: People whose bodies visibly reflect one of five elemental affinities, rather than a separate generic Elementaris species. Some are solid as stone, some carry ember patterns, others appear fluid, airy or illuminated by magical energy. Their silhouettes and voices may change with the environment; none of those forms should be mistaken for a separate current species.

subtypes.name: Earth
subtypes.appearance: Bark or stone textured skin, mosslike hair, weighty build, earthy fissures and a deep resonant voice.

subtypes.name: Fire
subtypes.appearance: Glowing ember veins, heatlike shimmer and hair that can suggest flame; specific color and physiology vary.

subtypes.name: Water
subtypes.appearance: Fluid, reflective skin and flowing hair or limbs that resemble currents; water effects need not imply constant liquid anatomy.

subtypes.name: Air
subtypes.appearance: Light, wind-swept features and shifting translucency, with clothing or hair that seems moved by unseen breezes.

subtypes.name: Aether
subtypes.appearance: Luminous magical auras, irregular light patterns and other non-elemental arcane features.

naming.template: Given name + optional elemental kin term; elemental affinity must not be inferred from the name.

structured_records.name: Jaspey
structured_records.appearance: Jaspey are recognized as one people with three established forms, Mosscap, Gloomtail, and Rotcap. Each form has identifiable surface markings or anatomy. Their shared underlying body plan is not specified in the surviving current reference, so no extra height, limb count, or facial anatomy is invented here.

subtypes.name: Mosscap
subtypes.appearance: A moss-textured head or crown, with soft green-brown highlights.

subtypes.name: Gloomtail
subtypes.appearance: A shadow-adapted tail or low-light markings.

subtypes.name: Rotcap
subtypes.appearance: Dark fungal or decay-associated patterning.

naming.template: Personal root + mushroom or shelter theme only by choice, not enforced by biological form.

examples.name: Lunkerai
examples.proposed_meaning: A light hidden in the grove

structured_records.name: Deorbasun
structured_records.appearance: Tall to towering magical shapeshifters, sometimes feline or beastlike, whose physiques vary from muscular to lithe. Fur, scales or earth-toned skin, reflective eyes, wings, tails or other animal features vary according to the individual's soul bond. No single default animal form applies to every member.

subtypes.name: Open Soul-Animal
subtypes.appearance: This is an open choice, not a preset wolf, cat or bird subtype. Record the person’s initial appearance and update markings or silhouette only after the true soul bond is established.

naming.template: Soul-animal relationship is optional in a given name. Family, habitat and earned titles may follow the name.

examples.name: Arutalka
examples.proposed_meaning: One who returns to the family

structured_records.name: Gandirosha
structured_records.appearance: Wiry or lithe agile figures, roughly three to six feet tall in the detailed source, with softly luminous skin and shifting freckle-like or sigil markings. Hair can range from honey and copper to chestnut, jade and gold. Eyes may glow subtly when magic is active; layered clothes and charms suit travel and performance.

naming.template: Personal root + relationship or journey root. The same name may appear in two community pronunciations.

examples.name: Goraeni
examples.proposed_meaning: A fortunate meeting on the road

examples.name: Enigora
examples.proposed_meaning: One who sees an unexpected route

structured_records.name: Gwynis
structured_records.appearance: Dream-born people with forms ranging from tall, shadow-touched silhouettes to luminous figures with weightless hair and shifting auroral features. Their eyes may appear to perceive several layers of reality. Intangibility and visual fluidity vary with magic and should not be assigned as a compulsory permanent body type.

naming.template: Dream image root + memory or witness root.

structured_records.name: Geisamahi
structured_records.appearance: Small, upright, ferret- or stoatlike people with compact wiry bodies, elongated muzzles, expressive eyes, twitching whiskers and opposable thumbs. Fur may be brown, russet, orange, snow white or patterned. Their movement is nimble and acrobatic, and they often carry small belts and handmade tools.

naming.template: Place or craft root + playful or affectionate repetition, chosen by the individual.
naming.syllable_pattern: CV.CV.CV, vowel harmony preferred within long names

examples.name: Sumitala
examples.proposed_meaning: One who finds the hidden route

structured_records.name: Tamhiogal
structured_records.appearance: Amphibious aquatic people with dramatic betta-fish coloration: brilliant blues, violets, teals, reds and shifting iridescence. On land they have scaled humanoid legs and arms, bioluminescent jellyfish-like hair, reflective eyes and scales at the face and neck. In water, gills, webbing, dorsal fins and a long caudal fin become prominent. They need hydration and tidal energy.

naming.template: Meaning root + water or family root; the second root may modify the first. Endings -a, -in and -eya are optional regional inventions.

examples.name: Nurfaleya
examples.proposed_meaning: A light returning with the tide

examples.name: Zawadira
examples.proposed_meaning: One who keeps a promise across the sea

structured_records.name: Aburata
structured_records.appearance: Infernal magical beings with a humanoid and a quadrupedal equine-inspired form. Humanoid skin can resemble obsidian, molten iron or violet stone, marked by ember veins and living sigils. Curved or bladelike horns, fire-bright or voidlike eyes, varied hair and a prehensile tail distinguish individuals. The equine form adds a muscular horse-like trunk and hooved legs.

naming.template: Chosen attribute root + kin or place root; reject automatic evil-coded names.

examples.name: Zerimana
examples.proposed_meaning: One who does not abandon family

structured_records.name: Volsarii
structured_records.appearance: Ethereal four-armed people with elongated ear horns, sensitive antennae, iridescent skin and luminous or nebula-like eyes. Hair can look like liquid light, drifting mist or fine feathers. They pass through several lives in service to Nyxarion; during the final life they develop wings. No fixed number of lives is established.

naming.template: Given name + service title only when actually held; life-stage titles are not compulsory.

examples.name: Soramira
examples.proposed_meaning: A passage under the open sky

structured_records.status: current MMORPG race document, approval relative to strict JSON pending
structured_records.appearance: Compact, densely muscled humanoids with thick bones, strong forearms, calloused hands and skin ranging from granite gray and earth brown to ember-red. Their eyes shine in jewel-like shades. All genders may wear decorated beards, rings and braids as family or achievement records. The source does not name separate biological subtypes.

naming.template: Apprenticeship or personal value root + craft or place root.

structured_records.status: current MMORPG race document, approval relative to strict JSON pending
structured_records.appearance: Fine-boned, slender, magic-dependent winged people with iridescent skin in lilac, silver, mint and pale blue. Luminous hair may carry petals or glimmers. Their wings can resemble butterfly, dragonfly, leaves or living light; these are documented variations in wing morphology, not four separately approved species.

subtypes.appearance: Broad patterned wing membranes; source-documented wing morphology, not a separate species.

subtypes.name: Bioluminescent-winged
subtypes.appearance: Wings patterned with active light; source-documented morphology.

naming.template: Nature or feeling root + flight, shelter or friendship root.

Tusks may bear rings or carvings. Eyes often resemble embers or dark steel, hair is thick and braided, and ears are elongated or battle-nicked. No current source supplies an approved biological bloodline list.

The usual unmixed skin-color range resembles fair to lightly tanned complexions seen among Italian, Slavic and Balkan human populations, without implying any shared Earth ethnic identity. Copper, deep copper, auburn and dark auburn are the most common hair colors. Brown appears sometimes, while black and blonde are rare. Silver, blue and green eyes are common, often with a distinctly oceanic shape, occasionally dual-toned or subtly reflective. High oceanic-style cheekbones, a slightly angular brow with shallow paired ridges, and long ears swept backward are defining traits. Ear tips range from moderately pointed to dramatically sharp and elongated, with individual variation. Some Aza'raans bear faint freckles, subtle psionic luminescence, or wave-like ritual markings. Kaluseban, Deorbasun, Zirramunis, Iamhazira and Gandirosha ancestry can introduce additional color, stature, ear, hair, eye, animal-associated, or magical characteristics; such variation does not redefine the typical unmixed appearance.

heritage_variations.name: Aza’raan with Kaluseban ancestry
heritage_variations.description: Kalus’aan is the established name for this mixed-ancestry community. Their Aza’raan cranial ridges, slender limbs, silver, blue, or green eyes and copper-to-auburn hair may mingle with Kaluseban color shifts, luminous marks, mineral textures, water-adapted accents, or forest and shadow features. The six documented Kalus’aan expressions are Arcane, Starborne, Wildroot, Tideborn, Stonebound, and Umbral; they are not six separate species. Appearance differs with the family and the particular Kaluseban bloodline.

heritage_variations.name: Aza’raan with Deorbasun ancestry
heritage_variations.description: An Aza’raan descendant of a Deorbasun family may keep pale-to-lightly-tanned Aza’raan skin and auburn or copper hair while expressing more pronounced reflective eyes, feline or other soul-animal hints, a heavier mane, unusual ear contours, tail, fur patches, claw-like nails, or rare wing features. The Deorbasun soul-animal bond is individually expressed and cannot be assigned a standard animal or fixed bloodline by appearance alone. No separate canonical community name has been established.

heritage_variations.name: Aza’raan with Zirramunis ancestry
heritage_variations.description: These descendants may be shorter or more densely built than a typical Aza’raan, with strong forearms, compact musculature, prominent bone structure, mineral-glinting eyes, stone-colored accent markings, and thick hair or beard growth. Copper and dark auburn hair and the silver, blue, or green Aza’raan eye spectrum can persist, with jeweled or metallic notes from Zirramunis heritage. No distinct mixed-species name or special fixed subtype is confirmed.

heritage_variations.name: Aza’raan with Iamhazira ancestry
heritage_variations.description: The historically documented Aza’zira community blends Aza’raan facial proportions, psionic markings, and reflective eyes with Iamhazira height, powerful musculature, endurance traits, braids, strong jaw structure, and sometimes tusk features. Complexion may extend beyond the unmixed pale-to-lightly-tanned baseline where that parental lineage is visible. Individuals may retain copper or auburn hair, or express their Iamhazira family’s tones and scar or ornament customs.

heritage_variations.name: Aza’raan with Gandirosha ancestry
heritage_variations.description: These descendants can retain the typical pale or lightly tanned Aza’raan complexion, copper or auburn hair and silver, blue, or green eyes, while expressing greater agility, a more compact or lithe build, freckles that resemble luminous sigils, more mobile facial expression, or colorful hair highlights associated with Gandirosha ancestry. These are variable family traits, not a separate named species or mandatory personality features.

structured_records.family_appearance_note: Pix family appearance canon: Pix is a transgender man who can pass as human despite his visibly pointed, backward-swept ears. The childhood name 'Pix' came from those conspicuous ears, which his parents explained as an old inherited abnormality. Pix and his father have the tell-tale pointed ears. Pix's mother, Jacob and Clarahmizah have ordinary-looking human ears without points. Pix's mother eventually explains that much of the protector bloodline shared by her and Clarahmizah has Gandirosha and Zirramunis ancestry, and many descendants lost the conspicuous Aza'raan ear shape. Pix inherited the unmistakable ears through his father. The absence of pointed ears does not erase anyone's Aza'raan lineage or protector heritage.
